title: Borscht-Flavored Ukrainian Beet Dumplings
description: A hearty Ukrainian-inspired dish filled with a sweet and sour beet-based filling, served as a main course. The beet flavor is enhanced by the addition of a borscht-based broth.

ingredients.name: Bitter greens (such as dandelion or arugula)

instructions: In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped beets and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, about 20 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the water, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, combine the egg and borscht broth. Mix well to combine.
Add the egg mixture to the beet mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the chopped bitter greens to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Knead the dough until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball slightly into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of the beet mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Gently add the dumplings to the pot and cook until they float to the surface, about 5-7 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
